name: tumwater
description: Opinionated autonomous development harness built on pi. You write the initial prompt; role-driven loops build the project.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && node scripts/tsc.mjs && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/live-checkout-guard.mjs && eslint . --cache && node scripts/tsc.mjs --incremental && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs && node scripts/check-permit.mjs node dist/test/test-runner.js
scripts.test:gate: node scripts/live-checkout-guard.mjs && node scripts/tsc.mjs --incremental && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs && node scripts/lint-changed.mjs --alongside node scripts/check-permit.mjs node dist/test/test-runner.js --affected --budget=20
scripts.test:rerun: node scripts/live-checkout-guard.mjs && node scripts/tsc.mjs --incremental && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs && node scripts/check-permit.mjs node dist/test/test-runner.js
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/live-checkout-guard.mjs && node scripts/tsc.mjs --incremental && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs && node scripts/check-permit.mjs node dist/test/test-runner.js e2e
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/live-checkout-guard.mjs && node scripts/tsc.mjs --incremental && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs && node scripts/check-permit.mjs node dist/test/test-runner.js --coverage
